limitations: Separate source and replica snapshots; aggregate matches do not certify full row parity
Endpoint identity verified only as configured PostgreSQL shared by app and ingestion; Supabase hosting not independently verified
Browser checked customer profile and manager overview/menu/reviews/surveys; other roles audited statically
Not a completed business coverage acceptance
Round 2 route inventory is static declaration evidence, not proof that every endpoint is registered/authorized/live-tested
JSON probes cover shapes and counts, not all nested values/versions; no Redis or client contents inspected
Delivery assignment key conflicts and gift transfer integrity are findings, not fixed or retrospectively reconciled
